title.zh: 规定各省初审法院书记官兼任当然郡长，其管辖不限于本省，亦及于设市前属该省的任何城市
title.en: An Act to Make the Clerk of the Court of First Instance of a Province Ex Officio Sheriff Not Only of Such Province But Also of Any City Which, Before Conversion to a City, Formed Part of Such Province
title.orig: An Act to Make the Clerk of the Court of First Instance of a Province Ex Officio Sheriff Not Only of Such Province But Also of Any City Which, Before Conversion to a City, Formed Part of Such Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_915_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The clerk of the Court of First Instance of a province shall be ex officio sheriff not only of such province but also of any city, which before conversion to a city, formed part of such province. As ex officio sheriff of a city, such clerk shall receive an additional compensation of not exceeding one thousand two hundred pesos, which shall be fixed by the city council or municipal board and payable from city funds.
Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred twenty-nine is repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
